arStrings.szText: Holy Light, please grant Adoné mercy. It was my fault she took this path. I am the cause, not her. (sighs) I ask this in Akarat’s name.
Saying a prayer under his breath.
(sighs) My friend, I do not deserve the kindness you have shown me.
To Player. Feeling guilty about everything that has happened.
I came to Skovos seeking Akarat’s hope. All these pilgrims did. But in a world such as ours, perhaps we were all fools.
I don’t know what to believe anymore. What is true…what is real.
Listen, if you truly wish to follow Akarat, then travel to the town of Samuk in Nahantu. There, you will find hope.
Reassuring, trying to help Bnatros find a new path in life
Take this—my pilgrim’s staff. Something to remember me by. Or not, if you choose. May the Light shine upon you, even in the darkest places.
Grateful, handing his staff to the Player
